propositions: epic-close bug screen degrades per-candidate LLM provider errors (ValidationException) to verdict C (unrelated) instead of propagating, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor when all candidates fail systematically
max_tokens never re-clamped when a model shrinks during structured_run execution, causing Bedrock ValidationException when a 128K ceiling rides into a 64K model

LLMUnavailableError and its subclass LLMConfigError must re-raise from screen_candidates._row (warm call and fan-out) and run_screen before degradation, failing the close consistently with absent-provider behavior
non-provider per-candidate failures (malformed output, store read errors) must continue degrading to C; only systemic LLMUnavailableError blocks the close
--force-close escape hatch must remain functional to bypass the verifier before the screen runs
